mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting aerobic ATP renewal to the pump made the contrast between active transport and passive channel flow concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the glucose carrier was straightforward but less interesting on its own; the subsequent conformational sequence supplied the useful explanation.

surprise.text: The respiration picture compactly distinguished fuel oxidation from oxygen's role in electron transfer and water formation, while retaining cytosolic ATP production.

arbitrary.text: No selected action felt purposeless, although the protein result marks GTP-supported steps without explaining GTP's particular role.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these cell-level mechanisms connect to tissues and organs, especially if later constructions explain their connections as clearly as the pump comparison.
